artifact_observations.location: Pastries on middle and bottom shelves
artifact_observations.reasoning: The textures of the baked goods appear slightly 'waxy' or overly smooth, lacking the fine crumb structure or flaky layers expected in high-resolution photography. Some edges blend into the trays slightly.

The geometry of the glass shelves and the reflections on them show minor inconsistencies. The vertical supports seem to warp slightly, and the reflection of the light source doesn't perfectly align with the physical light position, suggesting slight generative warping.
The items on the top shelf and in the deep background lack clear definition, appearing to merge with each other and the background environment more than optical blur would typically cause.

selected_experts.reason: To verify if the objects are correctly identified as specific types of pastries/bread rather than generic amorphous shapes.
To assess the realism of the lighting, glass reflections, and food textures which are critical for bakery images.
To check if the parallel lines of the shelves and glass panes maintain correct perspective and depth ordering.
To ensure individual pastries are distinct entities and not fused with their containers or neighbors.

focus_areas: Texture realism of baked goods (crumb, crust, glaze)
Optical correctness of glass reflections and refractions
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'waxy' appearance of the food items. AI often struggles with the complex micro-textures of baked goods. Also, scrutinize the glass reflections; inconsistent or physically impossible reflections are a strong indicator of generation artifacts. Check if the 'blur' in the background is natural depth-of-field or generative smearing.
